blog.title: We are officially LIVE!
blog.author: admin
blog.content:
Welcome to the **Rouse Science Olympiad site**\! I am extremely excited to announce that this site is finally up and running\!

This website will be your go-to place for team **updates**, event **info**, **announcements**, and **important** resources throughout the season. Whether you’re interested in joining, a parent of a kid in Science Olympiad, or, heck, competing in Rouse’s team *already*, we truly hope this site makes it easier to *stay up to date*\!

We’ll be updating this site quite often, so be sure to check back soon. Let’s make this an *awesome* year for **SciOly**\!\!
